title: Tax-free savings newsletter 24
text:
This newsletter is published by HMRC to update stakeholders on the latest news for Individual Savings Account ( ISA ) managers and Child Trust Fund providers.

 Tax-free savings newsletter 24 has articles on:

 • the reduced Lifetime ISA withdrawal charge for first-home purchases above the property price cap

 • next steps for Help to Save

 • retaining the cash ISA limit from 6 April 2027

 • First Time Buyer ISA 

 • 
 ISA compliance

 • Income Tax rates on savings income
